summary: S810.1 Readiness Forecast: 28 READY, 10 MINOR_REVIEW, 0 ESCALATE. All 38 Domain E seeds are technically certifiable (CCs verified, COSO-aligned, conceptually sound). Zero items require content redesign or CC change — this is a content-authoring closing task, not a correction task.
